result: Ordered output events verified in focusa-pty: GenerationReader preserves partial reads (split writes merged, no byte loss or reorder), every envelope carries the exact AttachmentKey, WorkSurfaceId, run generation, and monotonic sequence; stale generations cannot impersonate the current process (accepts_output generation + sequence gate); OutputAccumulator merges split writes. Process reader thread emits newline-terminated lines in order and flushes unterminated tails.
